market_brief: Monday's AI unwind (S&P 500 -1.9%, Nasdaq 100 -2.7%, SOX -5.3%, VIX 22.9) rolled through Asia, with the Kospi down 2.6% to a six-month low and the Nikkei -1.3%, while India opened modestly higher on oil relief and foreign inflows. Everything now hinges on Nvidia's results after today's US close (consensus ~$109B revenue; options price ~10% move), which sets the tone for Anthropic's IPO pricing Wednesday. Rates remain the other headwind: the US 10Y is 5.12%, a December Fed hike is ~91% priced ahead of Waller today, the RBA minutes kept more hikes open and DXY sits near 103.6. Brent (~$91.7) keeps sliding on glut forecasts, and gold, silver and Bitcoin (~$65k) are still not acting as havens.
ai_brief: Hardware dominated: Anthropic said its Mythos model ported a model to AMD GPUs in days, a direct challenge to Nvidia's CUDA moat on the eve of both companies' big market events, while Nvidia's Vera Rubin swept MLPerf. Microsoft shipped a local 138B coding model for Copilot, GitHub rotated its model lineup, and physical-AI money kept flowing with Agile Robots' $500M round.

items.headline: Update: Asian selloff deepens: Kospi -2.6% to a six-month low below 5,000, Nikkei -1.3%
items.summary: The chip rout spread through Asia on Tuesday: Kospi closed at 4,968, its first close under 5,000 since February, with Samsung Electronics -3.1%, while the Nikkei fell 1.3% to 58,860 and SoftBank Group lost 3.9% (down over 33% in a month). Earlier this morning the moves were ~1.4%; the declines widened through the session.

items.headline: Update: Sensex and Nifty open higher as investors rotate from global AI trades to India
items.summary: Sensex was up ~0.14% at 82,221 and Nifty at 25,327 shortly after the open, with softer oil helping. Foreign investors bought a reported Rs 84,290 crore of Indian equities in the first half of November after two months of net selling.

items.headline: Nvidia reports tonight: LSEG consensus ~$109B revenue, EPS up ~90% y/y; stock down ~24% in November
items.summary: Nvidia's fiscal Q3 results are due after Tuesday's US close, its first print since the CEO departure; options reportedly price a ~10.6% move. The stock fell 4.1% on Monday and is down nearly a quarter this month, per Reuters data cited by Shattered.

items.headline: Ratings round-up: CLSA trims Nvidia conviction; UBS upgrades Nucor; Goldman cuts Yeti; Evercore adds Spotify
items.summary: Per an EverHint aggregation: UBS raised Nucor to Buy (PT $307), Melius upgraded Ingersoll-Rand, Goldman cut Yeti to Neutral and Macquarie cut Bilibili to Neutral; Jefferies lifted its AppLovin target to $500, and Evercore ISI swapped Spotify in for Netflix among its top picks. Not independently verified against broker notes.

items.headline: Home Depot reports Q3 before the US open: consensus EPS $3.84 on $42.8B revenue
items.summary: Options imply roughly a ±5% move, well above HD's ~1.9% average post-earnings swing over the last four quarters. Piper Sandler trimmed its target to $371 ahead of the print, after Zelman's Underperform call on Monday.

items.headline: Fed's Waller speaks today with a December hike ~91% priced
items.summary: CME FedWatch shows roughly 91% odds of a 25bp December hike and ~9% for 50bp after October CPI ran hot (0.4% m/m headline). Waller, who earlier floated considering 50bp if core stayed near 0.3%, speaks Tuesday afternoon European time.

items.headline: RBA minutes lean hawkish: board leaves door open to more hikes after lifting cash rate to 4.60%
items.summary: Minutes of the November meeting, where the RBA hiked to 4.60%, set out three reasons for the move and kept further tightening on the table, per investingLive. AUD/USD fell 1% on Monday as risk appetite faded.

items.headline: PBoC fixes yuan at 6.7132, strongest since early 2023 but weaker than expected, ahead of APEC
items.summary: The midpoint came in well on the weak side of the 6.6715 Reuters estimate, signalling a brake on yuan gains; onshore yuan traded near 6.665. APEC in Shenzhen runs Nov 18-19 with a Xi-Trump-Putin meeting planned, per Reuters.

items.headline: Update: Brent slips further to ~$91.7 as Goldman and IEA flag a glut; US SPR at lowest since 1982
items.summary: After Monday's 3.6% drop, Brent was down another ~0.8% in Asia. Goldman sees Brent averaging $88 in 2027, the IEA projects a Q4 surplus of ~1.7M bpd, and the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve has fallen to 276M barrels.

items.headline: Gold and silver edge up from near one-year lows
items.summary: Gold futures rose ~0.4% and silver ~0.7% in Asian trade after Monday's slide, with both still pinned near one-year lows by rising rate-hike expectations.

items.headline: Bitcoin near $65k with Fear & Greed at 12; spot ETFs now net sellers year to date
items.summary: BTC was ~13% lower on the week in a $63.9k-65.5k range. SoSoValue data show US spot bitcoin ETFs at about $1.56B of net outflows year to date, and the crypto sentiment index sits in 'extreme fear'.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO: 825M shares at $70-78 could raise up to $64.4B; pricing Wednesday
items.summary: Per Reuters as cited by Shattered, the offering could value Anthropic at up to ~$1.4T, alongside a separate $26B placement with Google, Nvidia, AMD and Microsoft. No change to the range has been reported since Monday's coverage of strong demand.

items.headline: AI-infrastructure names hit hardest by the remote chip-access curb
items.summary: CoreWeave, Nebius, Lumentum, Sandisk and SK Hynix each fell 5%+ early Monday after the US moved to limit remote/cloud access to advanced AI chips, per Schwab's market update; the SOX ended -5.3%.

items.headline: Agile Robots raises $500M Series F at $8.5B valuation, led by SoftBank
items.summary: The Munich-based robotics maker's round included Nvidia, Hitachi and T.Capital, taking total funding to $2B; its new German plant can build up to 10,000 humanoid robots a year.

items.headline: Context: Monday's 1.9% S&P drop erased most of last week's 2.5% rebound
items.summary: The S&P 500 had posted its first weekly gain since early October in the week to Nov 13 before Monday's AI-led reversal; Nvidia's market value has fallen about $735B since the leadership disclosures, per AP.

items.headline: Today/this week: HD pre-market, Waller, Nvidia after close; Fed minutes + EIA + ANT pricing Wed; APEC Nov 18-19; OPEC+ Nov 29
items.summary: Tuesday brings Home Depot results, Waller's speech and Nvidia after the bell. Wednesday has the FOMC October minutes, EIA inventories and Anthropic's IPO pricing ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut; APEC in Shenzhen runs Nov 18-19.

items.headline: Anthropic tells IPO investors Claude Mythos ported a model to AMD MI355X GPUs in ~3 days
items.summary: In roadshow material, Anthropic said Mythos Preview wrote almost all kernels needed to run one model on AMD hardware, a job that reportedly took 6-12 months before; the footnote limits the claim to prefill for a single model.

items.headline: Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 sweeps MLPerf Training v6.1 in its debut
items.summary: Per Nvidia's results summary, Vera Rubin delivered up to 2x per-GPU performance vs GB300 NVL72 and scaled DeepSeek-V3 training to 1,024 GPUs at ~97% efficiency; a provisional agentic-inference result showed 10x+ throughput per watt.

items.headline: Microsoft ships MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, a 138B MoE coding model that runs locally in GitHub Copilot
items.summary: The 53 GiB mixed-precision checkpoint is available via Microsoft Foundry; speculative decoding reportedly doubled throughput at 120K-token inputs on an RTX Spark box. A Windows ML runtime preview and experimental llama.cpp/GGUF support also landed.

items.headline: Gemini side panel in Apps Script reaches general availability
items.summary: Google made its Gemini assistant generally available inside Apps Script for Workspace Business/Enterprise and Google AI Pro/Ultra users, rolling out over about two weeks.
items.source: DEV Community digest (citing Google Workspace Updates)

items.headline: GitHub Copilot retires Claude Opus 4.8/5 and GPT-5.6 Terra; adds Agents inbox and model-compare tool
items.summary: Copilot's latest release deprecates older Anthropic and OpenAI models in favour of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 variants, adds Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon, and introduces a VS Code inbox for agent sessions needing attention.

items.headline: Agile Robots raises $500M at $8.5B as physical-AI funding keeps flowing
items.summary: SoftBank led the Series F with Nvidia and Hitachi participating; the company cites 20,000 deployed industrial systems and capacity for 10,000 humanoids a year in Germany.

items.headline: London VC Plural closes a €1B fund aimed at European frontier-tech and AI founders
items.summary: The fund is Plural's largest, roughly double its 2024 vehicle, with about two-thirds earmarked for seed and Series A.

items.headline: Threat advisory flags ARTEX, an open-source agentic pentest framework, in live campaigns
items.summary: ThreatDefence published detection guidance for ARTEX, which it ties to campaigns including Storm-0940, adding to this week's concern over autonomous offensive AI tooling.

items.headline: Developer report: approved MCP write can execute twice in OpenAI's Responses API
items.summary: A user-reported bug on OpenAI's developer forum says a hosted read following an approved native MCP write can trigger the write a second time; OpenAI had not commented, per the listing.
